problem: The vertex arrays have batchEff=floor(warps*lanes/3)*3 elements. Truncating every index to countWidth-1 bits drops a live top bit at non-power-of-two capacities: capacity112 aliases vertices64..110 to0..46, and the three-entry minimum aliases vertex2 to0.
fix: Derive vertexIndexWidth=max(1,ceil(log2(batchEff))) and use it for input/output array indices and all three triangle vertex indices. No transfer, shader, VLEN or scheduling specialization.
